In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
HLA-DRB1* 13 is the first specific immunity gene to have been shown to protect brain aging.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
DRB1* 13 is sufficient to protect brain integrity over the years, and that the protective effect of this gene on brain integrity is not limited to the presence of the protective apoE2 gene.
